# @nifrajs/node-uws - LLM contract card

Serve a nifra app on uWebSockets.js from Node - the node-direct lane over uWS's native HTTP server.

> A tight contract card for AI agents: the exports you actually call + the footguns. For the full
> reference see [`api-reference.md`](../../api-reference.md) (every export + signature) and

## Key exports

- **serve** _(function)_ - `serve: (app: FetchHandler, options: ServeOptions) => Promise<UwsServer>`
- **FetchHandler** _(interface)_ - `interface FetchHandler`
- **NodeStopOptions** _(interface)_ - `interface NodeStopOptions`
- **ServeOptions** _(interface)_ - `interface ServeOptions`
- **UwsServer** _(interface)_ - `interface UwsServer`
- **UwsTlsOptions** _(interface)_ - `interface UwsTlsOptions`

## Footguns

- Serves the app on uWebSockets.js, which is installed from GitHub and ships no musl or Windows-arm64 binary; it has no WebSocket or static-file support, so use `@nifrajs/node` for those.
